summary: The signed-in mod.io user (client only, registry total 80). Read by ecl::mod::SubscriptionSyncSystem (Toolkit: iterates +0 with stride 0x140 against ModManager::GetAvailableMods = the subscribed mods), ecl::mod::PendingModReportsSystem, gui::AvailableModsSystem and gui::mod::RequestSystem (macOS). Only alive while signed in to mod.io; never seen alive. Not saved, not replicated.
